name: show_ansi_colors
title: Show the ANSI color table on the screen

origin.description: Print a sample of the ANSI colors.

arguments.name: colors
arguments.text: 8 prints the builtin styles. 256 prints the color cube and the grey ramp. Below 8, a short message is printed.

origin.details: The argument chooses which table to print. The paints inside the 256-color table still follow num_colors(), so the cube uses 256-color codes only when that count is at least 256. The 8-color table is laid out in columns of the width option.
origin.value: NULL when fewer than 8 colors were requested. Otherwise the table function, invisibly. The table itself is printed.

translation.description: Print a sample of the ANSI colors.

arguments.name: colors
arguments.text: None uses num_colors(). 8 and 256 select the two tables.

translation.details: The function prints and returns None. The 8-color layout pads with the same twelve-space field crayon uses, in columns of the width option. The 256-color cube calls style() at the current num_colors(), not at the colors argument.
translation.value: None. The table is written to stdout.
